_comment: Copy this file to custom_patterns.json (or point -custom-patterns at it) to add your own signatures. Missing file = no custom patterns, nothing breaks. Each entry is merged into the matching built-in list at the start of every scan run.

_fields.check: Which built-in list this joins: php (default), functions, js, or db.
_fields.pattern: A Go regexp (RE2 syntax). Same engine as the built-in patterns.
_fields.weight: low | medium | high — see scanner/confidence.go. Use 'high' only for something you're confident is never legitimate on its own; 'low' for anything that could plausibly appear in normal code, so it only escalates to Critical when corroborated by another signal.

patterns.desc: example: a webshell string seen on a compromised site of ours
